name: vai vem vem
description: vai vem vem is the Jamaican artist Dre50 stepping into the CWI orbit, co-produced by Black Lansky and released September 30, 2026 per CWI records. The production swings with the lilt of dancehall, the drums snapping in halftime patterns while sub bass and percussion keep the low end heavy and the groove laid-back. Dre50's delivery is smooth and confident, pitched vocals and vocal effects floating over keys and plucks that chime throughout the track. The mix is polished and warm, the rhythm section urgent enough to move a room without breaking its cool. For fans of dancehall and afrobeats, vai vem vem recalls the bounce of classic island sessions and sits alongside the global-facing rap records coming out of the CWI roster. In the vein of modern dancehall crossovers, it evokes a night cruise rather than a studio session, playful, seductive, and unmistakably Caribbean in its step. Black Lansky's co-production stamp is audible in the layering: atmospheric pads in the verses, 808 bass filling out the chorus, ad-libs doubling the hook. As Dre50's latest single, out now on Spotify, vai vem vem marks a confident new chapter and one of the freshest 2026 arrivals in the catalog.
